, a cave giant]] Cave giants are a type of earth elemental found in Khaz Algar. In combat, they use elemental earth attacks causing tremors, smashing rocks, and releasing torrents of earth on their foes. , a typical celestial tree.]] Celestial trees (also known as dreamcatcher trees, anima trees, great trees, great soul-trees, dream trees, and dreamtrees) are enormous trees found throughout Ardenweald. They serve as communities for the forest's inhabitants and are responsible drawing in anima, which condenses into animacones that fall to the ground and are used by the Night Fae to rejuvenate spirits of nature slumbering within Ardenweald's wildseeds. Each tree nestles a heart of the grove near its roots. If a heart is lost, the tirnenn are able to "sing" a new one into existence, though this is a process that takes many seasons. Chamber Door is found at in the southwest connecting room of Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. It can be opened with the Key of Shadows, acquired as part of the 2 o'clock step of the puzzle to acquire the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. The door is flanked by an Enigmatic Decrypting Device and a Scrying Orb.

Challenge Mode Season 1 is a -only PvE season. It began on 21 July 2025 with the release of Mists of Pandaria Classic and ended on 9 December 2025 with patch 5.5.3 and the release of the Throne of Thunder raid. Players who completed all challenge modes within a specified time limit will earn rewards when the season ends.

Challenge Mode Season 2 is a -only PvE season. It began on 9 December 2025 with the release of Mists of Pandaria Classic patch 5.5.3. Players who earn a Platinum time on all dungeons will earn rewards when the season ends.
Challenge Mode Season 3 is a -only PvE season that will follow Challenge Mode Season 2. The times and rewards for this season are currently unknown. <!--

Chance is Grandma Wahl's orange tabby cat found in Gilneas. During the quest Grandma's Cat, Lucius the Cruel uses Chance as bait to lure the adventurer out to be slain. The tides are turned, however, when Grandma Wahl turns out to be suffering the worgen curse as well. Chance accompanied Grandma during the Reclamation of Gilneas and was seen with her during the fight in Cathedral Square. After the battle, Grandma and Chance relocated to Stormglen Village.
